ModMetaData.name: Medieval Overhaul - Recycle Only 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Adds recycling only to Medieval Overhaul's existing mending bench. Does not add or replace any mending system. Recycle apparel, armor, and weapons into a durability-scaled fraction of their original materials while consuming Medieval Overhaul repair tools through the bench's native fuel system.
